parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join activities on molregno. Join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay CHEMBL1964022. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
